sentences.en: Purpose:To analyse MRI manifestations of trigeminal neurinoma.

sentences.en: Results The trigeminal neurinoma could be classified into three types: posterior cranial fossa type (8 cases), middle cranial fossa type (4 cases), and straddle type (24 cases).

sentences.en: Two of seven studies into acoustic neurinoma (a benign tumour of a nerve between the ear and brain) reported a higher risk after using mobiles for 10 years.
